hints.title: Aggregating Box and Chest Inventories
hints.text: Each box contains its own counts of apples and oranges, and may optionally contain a chest with additional fruits.

hints.title: Preserving Empty Chest Associations
hints.text: join boxes with chests using a left join so that boxes without a chest are not omitted.

hints.title: Null Coalescing and Total Sums
hints.text: use ifnull or coalesce on the chest fruit counts defaulting to 0, sum both counts across all rows, and return the aggregated totals.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT SUM(b.apple_count + IFNULL(c.apple_count, 0)) AS apple_count,
       SUM(b.orange_count + IFNULL(c.orange_count, 0)) AS orange_count
FROM Boxes b
LEFT JOIN Chests c ON b.chest_id = c.chest_id;
```

complexity.notes: Left outer join computes cumulative fruit sums with IFNULL default zeros.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: An inner join drops boxes that have null chest_id values, severely undercounting total fruits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A left join with primary key lookup takes O(B + C) linear time with minimal memory overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should identify the optional chest association requiring LEFT JOIN and null coalescing.
